name: Nathaniel
source:
Nathaniel is one of the students attending Sweet Amoris High. He is the president of the student body and is Amber's twin brother. He is dependable and easy to get along with.

Likes: detective, cats, Italian food, reasonable, hard working, kind people
Dislikes: sweets, dogs, students who are not serious, Castiel
